items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 零 in a received Shuowen seal-script style, with 雨 above 令. It illustrates the transmitted seal-script analysis, not the character’s earliest known form.
items.alt: Black seal-script outline of 零, with 雨 above 令.
items.selection_reason: The file is identified as 零 in Shuowen seal-script style and explicitly described as a modern redraw, so it helps illustrate the received form while keeping its historical limits clear.

limitations.text: This redraw does not document an ancient inscription or establish 零’s earliest graphic form; no verified oracle-bone or bronze form is available here.
The Shuowen tradition names 令 as the sound element, while the Duan Yucai edition reads 霝聲; the reason for this difference remains unresolved.
